test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The teacher said to me, “You have not followed my instructions properly.”

options.text: The teacher told me that I was not following her instructions properly.
The teacher told me that I had not followed her instructions properly.
The teacher told me that I had not been following her instructions properly.
The teacher told me that I have not followed her instructions properly.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The teacher told me that I had not followed her instructions properly.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reported speech in indirect speech requires changes in tense and pronouns.
 
• **In this case, "you have not followed" becomes "I had not followed."**
 
• The use of "had" indicates past tense.
 
• **The pronoun "you" changes to "I" as the speaker is reporting what was said to them.**
 
• Thus, the sentence in indirect speech will become:
 
 
• The teacher told me that I had not followed her instructions properly.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Incorrect. The tense is incorrect as it uses "was" instead of "had" and does not accurately reflect the past tense of the original sentence.
 
• Option 3: Incorrect. The use of "been" is unnecessary and changes the meaning of the sentence. The original sentence is in simple past tense.
 
• Option 4: Incorrect. The tense is incorrect as it uses "have" instead of "had" and does not accurately reflect the past tense of the original sentence.
